name: kevinmhorvath-hub
description: Kevin Horvath's Claude Code plugins — cybersecurity and AI tooling.

plugins.name: threat-intel-toolkit
plugins.description: Defensive IOC + vulnerability triage on free, key-free open-source intel: a subagent plus two skills (threat-intel-lookup and exploit-availability-check). No API keys required.

plugins.name: theboardroom
plugins.description: An AI executive board of directors (CEO, CFO, COO, CLO, CISO personas) that debates a business idea from each role's perspective and delivers an integrated Go/No-Go board memo.

plugins.name: linkedin-post-creator
plugins.description: Drafts polished LinkedIn posts about breaking AI and cybersecurity news in an established practitioner voice — hook-first, news-anchored, fact-checked, with sourced first-comment and hashtag suggestions.

plugins.name: ai-secure-client-docs
plugins.description: Generates AI Secure Integrators client engagement document packages (NDA, MSA, SOWs) from master templates. Private repo, personal use only — hardcodes local filesystem paths, not portable to other machines.
